result.name: QFORM-FRESH-TRANSVERSE-CURVED-SECTION-v1
result.statement: For a diffuse orthonormal two-frame (w,v) on one original-coordinate bank and an arbitrary transverse statistic B on a disjoint bank, the off-fold joint density of (L, lambda(V-v0)^2+beta B) is at most 4/(|lambda|r), uniformly in beta.

unresolved: The genuinely shared-bank transverse case with 0<|beta|<|lambda|r^2; arbitrary extra spectrum and global proof remain open.
next_step: Seek a weighted Fourier inequality retaining the off-fold cutoff while integrating the shared transverse phase before inversion; do not use a worst conditional density.
